 "data": "flowchart TD
 %% Client Layer
 subgraph Client [Client Browser / App]
 A[Next.js Client SPA]
 A1[Vapi Web SDK]
 A2[Socket.io Client]
 end

 %% API Gateway / Next.js Server
 subgraph NextJS [Next.js App Server / API Gateway]
 B[Next.js Middleware]
 C[Next.js API Routes]
 C1[Resume Handler]
 C2[Vapi Webhooks]
 C3[Code Execution Router]
 end

 %% Real-Time Communication
 subgraph Realtime [Real-Time Socket Server]
 D[Socket.io Server]
 end

 %% Python ML Services
 subgraph PythonML [FastAPI Python Microservices]
 E[FastAPI API Gateway]
 E1[Resume Parser]
 E2[ATS Score Checker]
 E3[Question Generator]
 E4[Feedback Engine]
 E5[(FAISS Vector Index)]
 end

 %% Databases and Caches
 subgraph Storage [Data & Cache Layer]
 F[(Firebase Auth)]
 G[(Firestore NoSQL)]
 H[(Redis Cache & Rate Limiter)]
 end

 %% External Services
 subgraph External [External Services & Sandboxes]
 I[Vapi Voice AI Platform]
 J[Google Gemini Pro / LLM API]
 K[Piston Code Execution Sandbox]
 end

 %% Connections
 A --> B
 B --> C
 A1 <--> I
 A2 <--> D
 C --> H
 C1 --> E
 C2 --> I
 C3 --> K

 E --> E1
 E --> E2
 E --> E3
 E --> E4
 E3 & E4 --> E5
 E3 & E4 --> J

 C --> G
 C --> F",
 "config": null
